brief:
Masked Israeli settlers launched a coordinated attack that wounded Palestinians and hospitalised Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine, Middle East Eye reported. Levine said she was kicked to the ground and beaten repeatedly during the assault.

The incident marks an escalation in settler violence against Palestinians and international press documenting conditions in the occupied territories. Details of the Palestinians' injuries and the specific location of the attack were not immediately available.
